en: Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a tram (car no. 35) running through a tree-lined square. Historic buildings and church towers are visible in the background, with a hill and additional structures behind them. At the bottom of the image is printed text identifying the scene, and beneath that is dense handwritten text in German dated 30 November 1903. The card has a decorative embossed border typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
